{{Quote|I have class at 0900. How about 1030? I bet Jaytee will know as much as I do!|Alexandra Winger|<ref name="Whispers in the Dark" />}}
'''Jaytee''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived on [[Garos IV]] and served as an operator with the [[Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Jaytee, pick up channel A.''"<br />"''Got it.|Mika Kaebra and Jaytee|<ref name="Whispers in the Dark" />}}
Jaytee attended the [[University of Garos]] as a young man, and was a contemporary of [[Alexandra Winger]] during her education.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|145|Jaytee}}</ref> He worked as an operator with the [[Committee of Seven for Garosian Unification|Garos Resistance]], serving in the underground's operations center alongside Winger, [[Wink Tasion]], [[Mika Kaebra]], and others. Manning his intercept station, Jaytee helped monitor communications between [[TK-32]] and his commanding officer and gain a fix on their location, and later helped uncover an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] plot to ship vital components from [[Garan]].<ref name="Whispers in the Dark" />
